# ue-asset-intake-toolset

> Pure core and Unreal adapter of an Unreal MCP toolset that imports, validates and normalizes 3D assets and textures with a provenance log. Python package `trysac-ue-asset-intake-toolset`, import name `ue_asset_intake_toolset`, MIT licensed, Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.

- [README](README.md): problem, install, usage example, public API

- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run the existing tests
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): threat model and limits
